subject.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits

question: Should OpenClaw core accept `models.providers.*.request.rateLimit` now as a narrow provider HTTP dispatch limiter, or should this wait for the broader rate-limit/pace product direction in the open trackers?
rationale: This PR adds a new public config surface under provider routing, and the linked rate-limit issues cover broader product behavior that is still open and maintainer-labeled for product review.

options.title: Accept Narrow Limiter After Rebase
options.body: Approve the default-off provider HTTP dispatch slice, require the current-main sentinel conflict to be resolved, and leave broader budgets/status/backoff work in the trackers.

options.title: Hold For Broader Rate-Limit Design
options.body: Keep or close this PR until maintainers decide the complete rate-limit, pace, budget, and observability model across providers and agents.

options.title: Move To Plugin/External Policy
options.body: Decline a core config knob for now and steer pacing to provider-specific plugins or operator-side gateways until a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Limiter After Rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the default-off provider HTTP dispatch slice, require the current-main sentinel conflict to be resolved, and leave broader budgets/status/backoff work in the trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the provider request transport/config seam that this PR extends, making them the best available owner for the API-shape decision.
